paragraph_reviews.paragraph: A calculation can reach a point at which the operation it requests has no value under its present rules. A description can fail to cover a point which another description reaches. A closed journey in one space can remain open in a related space. In each case the difficulty makes a containing relation available for investigation: what was being calculated, represented or identified, and under which conditions?
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: A failed calculation, a missing chart value and a lifted path are the same obstruction.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The opening deliberately places three obstructions together.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: Their respective rules, domains and maps establish the question each asks.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: **Reframing changes that containing relation while accounting for the work already done.** Sometimes it introduces another coordinate; sometimes another space or another law. Adding a dimension is one possibility, not the definition of every change. What survives must be specified: an old value on its domain, a point under a change of coordinates, an equivalence class under a quotient, or the reason a former operation was forbidden. Preservation can concern the truth of a scoped result without preserving every old permission in the new system.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Every reframing adds a dimension and preserves all prior permissions.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The record is named dimensional reframing and promises an accountable continuation.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: A domain extension, chart transition and ring collapse preserve different respects; the original global preservation claim was false.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The [Advent of Zero](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-advent-zero-subject/SOURCE.md) gives this movement its sourceward force. The sign becomes exact through its operations; an exceptional use then makes those operations disclose their conditions. Mathematical refusal is productive because it tells us what a proposed continuation would have to change. The [immutable gap](../arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) follows a further relation: the act which makes a frame explicit is itself an act within a field, not a position finally outside every frame.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: An explicit account finally stands outside the conditions of accounting.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The operation makes its own frame visible.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The newly made account remains an act within a field; this is the immutable-gap operation itself.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: [Colebrooke's Bhāskara passages](../sources/mathematics-logic/brahmagupta/colebrooke-1817-brahmagupta-bhaskara/SOURCE.md#colebrooke-1817-brahmagupta-bhaskara-q002) preserve a different historical office: a fraction with zero denominator is retained, and the subsequent rule is accompanied by a theological image of immutability. The expression, its permitted transformations and that image remain distinguishable. [Dutta's analysis](../sources/mathematics-logic/dutta/dutta-2023-zero-divided-numbers-india/SOURCE.md#dutta-2023-zero-divided-numbers-india-p001) asks which familiar cancellation and cross-multiplication rules are actually allowed in the exceptional regime. The altered operation must be judged through those rules.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Retaining Bhāskara’s expression gives it every ordinary cancellation law, or the accompanying theological image supplies those laws.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: A historical expression and theological image occur beside a modern reconstruction.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: Expression, allowed transformation and image have different operations; the source cards bind their exact offices.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: One explicit modern construction illustrates the difference. Set $\iota(x)=x^{-1}$ for nonzero $x$, but $\iota(0)=0$, and define $D(a,b)=a\iota(b)$. This new operation has a value for every pair. It gives $D(6,0)=0$, while $0D(6,0)=0\ne6$: it has not made zero a multiplicative inverse. Ordinary addition and multiplication remain, and the inverse law retains its nonzero condition. The [division-pluralisms Matheme](../../matheme/formal-neighbours/division-pluralisms.md) develops this construction alongside the historical expressions without identifying them.

paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The explicit countercalculation 0D(6,0)≠6 states exactly which inverse law fails; the modern construction remains separately defined.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: [Making zero invertible under all ring laws](../sources/mathematics-logic/dutta/dutta-2023-zero-divided-numbers-india/SOURCE.md#dutta-2023-zero-divided-numbers-india-p002) instead collapses the ring to one element. A changed system need not preserve the distinctions with which it began.

paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: With the ring laws retained, 0=1 and all elements coincide; this is the necessary limiting case for preservation.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: A second kind of continuation changes a domain rather than a law. For $t\ne0$, $t^2/t=t$. Extending the resulting function by $g(0)=0$ gives a continuous function on the whole real line. The original quotient remains undefined at zero. Its extension agrees with every value it previously had. The [zero-reception dossier](../dossiers/zero-reception.md#1--a-numeral-receives-rules-and-rules-meet-an-exception) receives this exact discrimination among a retained sign, a new operation and an extended function.

paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: Agreement on the old domain and the added value are distinct from evaluating the original undefined expression.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The mediant begins with pairs. Between neighbours written $a/b$ and $c/d$, insert $(a+c)/(b+d)$. Starting from the formal boundaries $0/1$ and $1/0$ gives $1/1$, then $1/2$ and $2/1$. No division by zero was performed to add the components of these pairs.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: The boundary notation 1/0 already performs division by zero.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: Mediant insertion begins with fraction-shaped boundary pairs.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: Componentwise addition acts on integer pairs before their finite quotients are evaluated.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: When $b,d>0$ and $a/b<c/d$, the inserted fraction lies between them: subtracting $a/b$ gives $(bc-ad)/(b(b+d))>0$, and subtracting the mediant from $c/d$ gives $(bc-ad)/(d(b+d))>0$. If $bc-ad=1$, any common divisor of $a+c$ and $b+d$ divides $c(b+d)-d(a+c)=1$; the inserted fraction is reduced. The boundary pair can thus generate exact finite determinations while retaining a different office from the quotients between it. [Kaplan's numerical itinerary](../sources/mathematics-logic/kaplan/kaplan-1999-nothing-that-is/SOURCE.md) supplies the author's encounter with this construction; these local calculations state the operation used here.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Every mediant is reduced or the finite inequality calculation applies when a denominator is zero.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The construction includes zero-denominator boundaries and a coprimality statement.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: Positive denominators and determinant one are explicit hypotheses; the calculation proves only the operation stated.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: An added dimension has its own exact work. No real number has square $-1$. Write complex numbers as pairs $a+ib$, with multiplication $(a+ib)(c+id)=(ac-bd)+i(ad+bc)$. Then $i^2=-1$, and multiplication by $i$ sends $(a,b)$ to $(-b,a)$: a quarter-turn whose second application reverses both signs. Real numbers remain the pairs with second coordinate zero. Their old no-real-solution result remains true, while the enlarged domain supplies a solution. The multiplication rule, not the extra coordinate alone, earns that change.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Adding an arbitrary coordinate alone solves x²=-1, or the complex solution falsifies the old real no-solution result.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: A new domain is introduced as a dimensional enlargement.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The multiplication rule earns the solution while the real embedding preserves its prior scoped result.

The [projective construction](../../matheme/formal-neighbours/division-pluralisms.md) makes the new permission and the remaining failure visible together.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The squared coordinates sum to one. The missing north pole $(0,0,1)$ receives the point at infinity; away from it, $(X+iY)/(1-Z)$ recovers $z$. [NIST's extended complex plane](../sources/mathematics-logic/nist/nist-dlmf-2026-complex-variable/SOURCE.md#nist-dlmf-2026-complex-variable-q001) locates this completion. A second chart uses $w=1/z$ on nonzero finite points and $w(\infty)=0$. Infinity has become an ordinary local coordinate origin. Both the plane and sphere have two real local dimensions; the completion changes the global space rather than adding a local coordinate dimension.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: Motion also has to be translated: $dv/dt=-u^{-2}du/dt$. A coordinate velocity cannot simply keep the same numeral through an inverse coordinate change. With $u=3$ and $du/dt=2$, the other coordinate has $dv/dt=-2/9$; either height formula then gives $dy/dt=6/25$. The [manifold-atlas construction](../../matheme/topology/manifold-atlas.md) preserves the point and its motion by changing the expressions which describe them.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: Differentiation supplies a precise neighbouring operation. On an interval, $F(x)=x^2$ and $G(x)=x^2+7$ both have derivative $2x$. Their different constants have disappeared from that result. Conversely, all primitives of $2x$ on the interval have the form $x^2+C$. A condition such as $G(0)=7$ selects one of them. [The antiderivative theorem](../sources/mathematics-logic/strang/strang-herman-2016-openstax-calculus-v1/SOURCE.md) states the interval condition under which this difference is a constant.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The derivative remains exact. Its inability to recover a particular constant concerns information the operation did not preserve, not general unreliability of finite knowledge. In the native $\infty/dx$ relation, this becomes a concrete witness to an exact local determination retaining a horizon it cannot reconstruct from its value alone. The result can therefore demand a further condition without losing the precision it already achieved.

Rational $\alpha$ permits a common period; irrational $\alpha$ does not. paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The [mathematics history](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/mathematics/DEVELOPMENT.md#3--re-entry-representation-and-retained-passage) receives a differentiated account of continuation. Restricted cancellation changes algebraic permissions. A function extension adds values while agreeing on the old domain. A projective reciprocal acts on points. A coordinate transition changes descriptions. A quotient identifies representatives, and a cover lets a path be lifted from a chosen starting point. An initial condition can recover information which differentiation omitted. Each return names both its gain and the relation through which the earlier work remains accountable.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: The named transformations are interchangeable mechanisms.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The final return gathers algebra, geometry and calculus into one relation.

Their whole actions give reframing a lived return instead of serving as names for mathematical constructions.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: [Paradox and the containing field](C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field.md) carries this pressure into the means of knowing and acting. A changed source, comparison rule or criterion can alter a subsequent judgment. [Homologia / Analogia](../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#e5-whole-returns) keeps the comparison exact: the shared movement is a determination returning through its conditions, while the mathematical map and the lived transformation retain their different operations. A proposed correspondence which fails must itself be revised.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The boundary has now disclosed a task. The next act can inherit the calculation, the reason it stopped, and the precise change through which inquiry continued. Zero returns as more than an excluded input: the exception has made the means of determination available without cancelling the determinate result.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: The newly disclosed exception erases all formerly valid calculation.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: Zero returns after earlier refusal of an operation.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The scoped result and the reason it stopped remain available; the return makes their determining conditions explicit.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: A paradigm ordinarily works through what it lets us see, distinguish and do. Its rules disappear into successful judgments. An encounter becomes a crisis of that paradigm when its achieved determinations can no longer be held together by the relation under which they acquired their standing. Another answer of the same kind will not settle the difficulty. The means of answering has entered the problem.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: A crisis of the means can be resolved by another result under the same unchanged relation.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The opening distinguishes an encounter the paradigm cannot hold from an ordinary wrong answer.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The means of judging has itself become the object of inquiry.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: **Paradox is the pressure through which a containing relation can become available to transformation.** The pressure must first be understood. An invalid inference calls for correction; a genuine contradiction exposes incompatible commitments; an apparent contradiction may disclose two different descriptions of one event. A tension in a life can make its habitual terms of judgment untenable without being a formally inconsistent set of propositions. Their different tasks become legible when the argument preserves what each determination actually claims.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Every error or lived tension is a formal contradiction with one shared remedy.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: Paradox is introduced as a cross-register pressure.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: Invalid inference, inconsistent commitments, compatible descriptions and lived tension require different acts of recovery.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: [Genesis / Paradigm / Project / Epi-Logos](../etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD.md#paradox--crisis-of-the-containing-paradigm) gives this pressure a definite place. Genesis names generative source; Paradigm names an organisation of the means; Project is an achieved form thrown forth through them. The project returns an encounter that the enacted paradigm cannot accommodate. In $0/1$, the mediating slash becomes something inquiry must examine, rather than an invisible passage between fixed terms. Paradox acts through this relation as its crisis and return.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Paradox is another item inside an unchanged paradigm, rather than an operation on its relating means.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: Genesis, Paradigm and Project are given their distinct offices.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The achieved project’s return can expose the mediating slash and change the relation in which further projects become possible.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: Membership entails non-membership, and non-membership entails membership. There is no further observation which will choose a consistent value while all those permissions remain. The [Russell construction](../../matheme/formal-neighbours/russell-types.md) exposes formation and self-substitution together. [Russell's type principle](../sources/mathematics-logic/russell/russell-1908-theory-types/SOURCE.md#russell-1908-theory-types-q001) responds by restricting admissible definitions.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Observation can choose a consistent truth value while unrestricted formation and self-substitution remain unchanged.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: R∈R iff R∉R has just been derived.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The contradiction is generated by the permissions; choosing an empirical value cannot satisfy both implications.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: A simple hierarchy illustrates one repair: an object of type $n$ can belong to a collection of type $n+1$, so the self-membership expression is inadmissible. Collections can still become members of collections at an appropriate level. A second repair, separation, begins with an already given set $S$ and forms $R_S=\{x\in S:x\notin x\}$. The argument now entails $R_S\notin S$; separation never promised that its result belonged to its input set. One repair changes what can be expressed; the other restricts what can be collected. Both retain constructive work without retaining the inconsistent package of permissions.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Types prohibit all collection membership, or separation repeats unrestricted comprehension and requires its result inside its input set.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: Two different repairs follow the same contradiction.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: Admissible levels preserve higher collection work; bounded separation entails R_S∉S without promising R_S∈S.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The [Formal Limit dossier](../dossiers/formal-limit.md#russell-formation-and-repair) keeps that positive consequence distinct from incompleteness in a consistent theory. A contradiction is not a theorem merely awaiting proof, and an unproved sentence is not thereby contradictory. The transformed account must carry the actual reason its former form failed.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: An inconsistent theory only needs the missing proof of an unproved proposition.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: Logical failure and formal limits are discussed together.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: Contradiction and incompleteness have different hypotheses and require different repairs.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: [Cusa's learned ignorance](../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/cusa/cusa-on-learned-ignorance/SOURCE.md#cusa-on-learned-ignorance-q002) puts another pressure on determination: finite comparison does not possess the infinite Maximum. A polygon can approximate a circle increasingly closely while every finite polygon remains distinct from it. The approximation's success makes its respect more exact; it does not abolish the difference between the figures. Cusa's theological inquiry concerns the finite intellect's relation to what its comparisons cannot exhaust. Its change in knowing differs from a rule that prevents self-membership.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Finite polygonal approximation becomes identical with its limit figure, or Cusa’s theological argument is a type restriction.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The finite/infinite comparison follows Russell as another pressure on determination.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The approximation and infinite Maximum keep their own respects, not the logical operation of eliminating self-membership.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The native relation begins with $0$ as uncounted source and $1$ as manifest determination. The One appears through the All; the All remains dependent on the One. $0/1$ reads source through manifestation, while $1/0$ reads the achieved manifestation returning toward its source. Their equality in QL names one relation in inverse orientations. Direction and office remain different within that unity.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Inverse QL orientations erase their direction or the distinction between source and determination.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The two orientations are said to be one relation.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: Their unity holds the direction and office of each term rather than identifying every operation.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: Ordinary arithmetic makes the contrast exact: $0/1=0$, while a nonzero numerator has no quotient by zero in a nontrivial field. The ontological equality does not remove this asymmetry. Its force is to hold numerical determination together with the source-relation which no numerical determination can exhaust. The [Advent manuscript](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-advent-zero-subject/SOURCE.md) and the [complete theorem](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) develop the return from exact number into symbolic relation.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: QL equality changes ordinary arithmetic so that a nonzero quantity has a field quotient by zero.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The same written 0/1 and 1/0 forms appear in arithmetic and ontology.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The nontrivial-field asymmetry stays exact while symbolic recognition develops the relation its numerical terms do not exhaust.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The two logics disclose different ways of meeting the pressure. Signed opposition legitimately distinguishes $-1$ and $+1$; their sum is zero. If this cancellation is made the whole account, their containing relation disappears with the cancelled quantities. The directed differences are $(-1)-(+1)=-2$ and $(+1)-(-1)=+2$. When one pole takes this doubled magnitude as its possession of the whole span, its accounting suppresses the common relation. Directed difference remains exact; it is not another sum of the original signed terms. A third movement keeps the break available: the achieved $1$ encounters its inability to exhaust the source as $1/0$, and follows that dependence until the always-related $0/1$ becomes recognisable.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: A closed torus loop and its displaced plane lift are compatible through a covering map. For $\gamma(t)=[2t,-t]$, closure at $t=1$ downstairs accompanies endpoint $(2,-1)$ upstairs. The initial puzzle arose from demanding one meaning of return across two related spaces. [Dimensional reframing](C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) specifies their map and preserves both results. Here no contradiction in the mathematics had to be made true. What changed was an incomplete account of the relation.

paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The torus example follows a discussion of productive paradox.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The covering map already makes both results compatible; the changed object is the inadequate account.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: A paradigm can similarly make its own means available. It can recover an excluded source, distinguish a remembered event from present evidence, or disclose a criterion which had been mistaken for a property of the object. But every new representation is still a determination. [The immutable gap](../arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) is this recurrent difference between the account and the act which makes it: including a condition adds real knowledge while occurring through further conditions. Reflexivity gains precision without attaining a final position outside its own field.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Making the means explicit yields a final account outside all further conditions.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The paragraph celebrates genuine reflexive access.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The new representation is a determination produced by another act; its increased precision is compatible with non-exhaustion.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The distinction gives paradigm-change its test. Replacing one result with another under an unchanged criterion is a change of content. A paradigm changes when the constituting relation changes: what can count as evidence, which differences can matter, how a response can alter judgment or action. The previous result remains available with the conditions under which it was produced; a false conclusion need not remain accepted merely because it helped reveal those conditions.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Every old conclusion must remain accepted after a paradigm changes, or replacing an answer alone changes its criterion.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The recovery retains a former result and its generating conditions.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The result can be retained as evidence of the old operation without retaining it as true; criterion change differs from content change.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: [The order of dependence](../arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) places this activity within Life / Mind. Subjective Immediacy is the knower; Objective Internality the means; World the known. A self-description can change the means without becoming an exhaustive possession of the knower. The question returns to what the made account permits another encounter to do.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: A self-description acquires the knower as an exhaustive object by expanding the means.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: Life/Mind is articulated as knower, means and known.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: A transformed means remains in its office, rather than becoming the whole by accumulating descriptions.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The metabolic fork makes the consequence felt. Assimilation lets what enters change the life that receives it. In the Saturnine variant, the mouth takes in only to detain: nothing may alter the consuming measure. Head and tail have been gathered without a living return. Paradox becomes transformative where the interpretation itself can change, rather than consuming every challenge as another confirmation. The same whole image retains the Eden fork, where opposed valuations claim the field in place of the opening. Its return restores discernment within relation rather than making every distinction disappear.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Any consuming return is transformative or overcoming rigid valuation abolishes discernment.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The whole image juxtaposes assimilation, Saturnine detention and Eden’s fork.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: Assimilation changes the receiving life; detention preserves its ruling measure; retained opening allows distinctions without their usurpation of the whole.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: [Symbolon Dynamics](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE.md), developed through the [encounter with Van Eenwyk](../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE.md), follows the passage from the known through the unknown and back. In the native $x\to X\to x$ reading, the particular formation returns through a determining capacity it does not exhaust. The second $x$ is still particular, but its way of receiving and responding can have changed. The return concerns a changed manner of interpretation, not a new item added to the same fixed categories.

paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The same x symbol recurs after X.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: [Complexio oppositorum](C36-Complexio-Oppositorum.md) names the capacity to bear differentiated tension within a whole; [individuation](C34-Individuation.md) gives that capacity a sustained life. Another person's answer is decisive at this point. Shared being does not entitle my account to speak that answer in advance. The Other can resist the terms in which I interpreted the encounter and thereby change those terms. Their participation in the whole includes this irreducible power of reply.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Shared being lets my account supply another person’s answer in advance.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: Unity and individuation are considered within one whole.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The Other’s resistance and reply can change the terms; that positive power is what unity must retain.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: [Gebser's co-present structures](../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md) give another form to the release of exclusivity. Perspectival achievement remains usable while its claim to exhaust the field loosens. In the authorial reading of Gebser, perspective becomes context: being with the text and subtext includes concern for the outcome. This is participation made more explicit, not detachment equipped with a larger inventory. The old structure need not be annihilated for its former authority to change.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: A new consciousness structure simply destroys all older capacities, or integral participation means detached accumulation.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: The technical return has the same demand for a definite change. A forecast may be corrected while its target remains fixed. A returned consequence may instead show that the target omitted something on which the task depended. Then a criterion or commission must change, and the next act must actually inherit that revision. [Traversal with return](../conjugate/A17-prime-Traversal-with-Return.md) distinguishes corrected observation, revised model, altered criterion and changed commission. A proposed change and an enacted one remain different events.

paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The paragraph names several possible returns from an encounter.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The next act must inherit the relevant enacted change; observation, model, criterion and commission are different targets.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: **Paradigms live by their capacity to metabolise paradox.** The criterion names an achieved transformation, not a reward for multiplying conflicts. Suppression, appropriation and endless oscillation can keep a conflict active without altering the terms which produced it. Epi-Logos gives the return its positive office when recognition changes the lived means of further articulation. Its [Genesis–Paradigm–Project relation](../etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD.md#01--epi-logos--paradigmatic-reflexivity) receives the changed capacity rather than another label for the original impasse.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: Paradox guarantees growth merely by recurring, being held, or multiplying.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The aphorism says paradigms live by metabolising paradox.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: The criterion is actual transformed capacity; suppression, appropriation and endless oscillation can preserve the original obstacle.

paragraph_reviews.paragraph: [Homologia / Analogia](../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#relational-growth) keeps these returns proportionate. A covering map relates specified spaces; a logical restriction changes admissible formation; psychic reorganisation changes how a particular life holds an encounter. Their comparison carries the transformed relation without exchanging their warrants. [Sensitivity to origins](../arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) preserves responsibility to those through whom the new act becomes possible. [Integral Zero](../arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) receives the exact sign as living Symbol again. What returns is a means capable of another answer, with the source it cannot own still active within its use.
paragraph_reviews.mistaken_proposition_prevented: A mathematical theorem warrants a psychic or ethical consequence merely because their returns resemble one another.
paragraph_reviews.textual_reason_inference_is_live: The close gathers covering, logical and psychic transformations.
paragraph_reviews.necessary_information_lost_on_deletion: Each specified operation retains its own warrant; ethical sourceward responsibility is supplied by its actual argument and return.
